principles: A valid timing target must be treated as an architectural requirement, not merely an SDC value.
Do not solve timing failure by relaxing the user requested frequency.
Primary data inputs should not traverse a complete multiply-accumulate datapath before the first sequential boundary.
Arithmetic pipeline stages must be selected according to technology, precision, datapath width and measured timing.
Systolic activation and partial-sum propagation latencies must remain cycle-aligned.
Valid signals must be pipelined with the exact data transaction they describe.
Pipeline insertion must preserve mathematical functionality and dataflow semantics.
Every architecture-changing timing optimization must be functionally reverified before PPA comparison.
prohibited_shortcuts: relax target clock to claim closure
change INT8 or INT32 precision without authorization
replace systolic fabric with behavioral matrix multiplication
